notablePrerequisites: Market Festival attached to a basic land you control.
description:
Activate the basic land with Market Festival attached by tapping it, adding {1}.
Market Festival triggers, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saproling, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.
